name: Nekomimi Hime to Futari no Kishi-sama
original_name: 猫耳姫と二人の騎士サマ
source:
One morning, I woke up and...something was clearly wrong with my body.
Cat ears were growing on my head, and I even had a tail...!?
How could I turn into a cat so suddenly?? I can't believe it! I don't want to believe it!!!

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150425100049/http://sytry.org:80/neko33_knights/]official website[/url]]
